methodology.ground_truth: three-edge-projection CPU visible-edge extraction using identical scene vertices and orthographic camera; current owner decision in docs/decisions.md
methodology.threshold: 8-bit grayscale <128 after alpha composite on white
methodology.exact: Pixel precision, recall and harmonic-mean F1 with no spatial tolerance
methodology.tolerant: Precision matches predicted pixels within a Euclidean disk of radius DPR around target pixels; recall reverses roles. Radius is exactly 1 CSS pixel. F1 is harmonic mean; matching is many-to-many, not skeleton or topology accuracy.
methodology.cylinder_interior: Visible front half of source paper drum, middle 50% of world-space height, projected and eroded by 2 CSS pixels. False pixels exclude any pixel within 1 CSS pixel of a CPU target line. On one horizontal row per CSS pixel, count contiguous false runs and divide by the row ROI width in CSS pixels, times100; report mean across rows.
methodology.stroke: Nearest thresholded contiguous run within 2 CSS pixels of the clean drum right silhouette midpoint; report threshold width and full-profile integrated darkness. Only width1 +/-0.25 is treated as a requirement from the handoff.
limits: Single synthetic stand-in scene, not art quality or approval.
DOM labels are hidden before capture.
One clean-cylinder profile cannot establish all-angle stroke widths.
Pixel F1 is sensitive to rasterizer phase, thickness and occlusion semantics.
The primitive check validates convex outer silhouettes, not all hidden/intersection edges.
Cylinder ROI may miss defects elsewhere; no quality cutoff was invented for F1 or density.
Unsupported or missing cells remain explicitly unmeasured.
